in_sanskrit.name: शर्वम
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The word 'sharvam' is derived from the Sanskrit root 'shar', which means 'to shine'. It refers to that which is radiant, glorious, and auspicious. It is often used to describe divine beings and sacred objects.

in_hindi.name: शर्वमान
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name 'Sharvman' can be derived from the Sanskrit word 'sharvam', which means 'auspiciousness, glory, splendor, or radiance'. The name 'Sharvman' in Hindi can be translated as 'the auspicious one'. The first part of the name, 'Sharv', is derived from the Sanskrit root 'shar', which means 'to shine'. The second part of the name, 'Man', is a suffix that means 'one'. So, 'Sharvman' can be understood as 'the one who possesses the quality of shining or being radiant'.
